books.title: The Snow Day
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: It snows all night. In the morning the world is white.
Emma puts on her coat, hat, and gloves. She runs outside.
Emma makes a big snowman. She gives him a carrot nose.
Emma throws a snowball at her brother. He laughs and throws one back.
Emma goes inside for hot chocolate. It is the best snow day ever.

books.title: Lily's Garden
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Lily has a little garden. She plants some seeds in the soil.
Lily waters the seeds every day. She waits and waits.
One day a tiny green shoot comes up. Lily claps her hands.
The shoot grows and grows. Soon it has pink flowers.
Lily picks the flowers and gives them to her mum. Her mum smiles.

books.title: The Happy Bee
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A happy bee buzzes in the garden. Her name is Bella Bee.
Bella Bee flies from flower to flower. She hums a buzzing song.
She drinks the sweet nectar. Then she flies back to her hive.
In the hive, Bella Bee makes honey. The honey is sweet and gold.
The bees share the honey. Bella Bee is the happiest bee of all.

books.title: The Rainy Day
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: It is a rainy day. Rain falls on the roof.
Anna has a red umbrella. She opens it up.
Anna jumps in the puddles. Splash, splash!
The sun comes out now. The rain is gone.
Anna sees a big rainbow. It is red, yellow and blue!
